Case Study: TechiesMatch

The Challenge

The online dating market is saturated, but we identified a gap for tech professionals who seek partners with similar interests and career paths. Mainstream apps often failed to capture the nuances of this demographic, leading to low-quality matches and user fatigue.

The Process & Solution

The core innovation was a machine learning algorithm that went beyond simple profile data. It analyzed users' interests, communication styles, and in-app behavior to predict compatibility. This resulted in a 40% improvement in match compatibility rates.

I also designed an A/B testing plan for the onboarding flow, which successfully reduced the drop-off rate by 28%.

The Impact

Our data-driven approach yielded significant results within the first three months post-launch:

  • User retention increased from 45% to 75%, a 67% improvement.
  • The AI-driven match recommendations led to a 35% increase in daily active users.

Case Study: HealthTrackNG

The Challenge

In many underserved communities across Nigeria, accessing healthcare is a significant challenge. Patients face long wait times, a lack of information about available services, and difficulties in booking appointments, especially in low-connectivity environments.

The Process & Solution

Based on on-the-ground user research, we prioritized core accessibility features like Offline Functionality and Multilingual Support (English, Hausa, Yoruba). Partnering with local clinics, we integrated their schedules, allowing for real-time booking which reduced average appointment wait times by 50%.

The Impact

HealthTrackNG made a tangible difference in the communities it served:

  • Successfully onboarded over 10,000 active users within six months of launch.
  • Achieved a 95% user satisfaction rate in post-launch surveys.

Case Study: SubtleFlow

The Challenge

Personal finance management is tedious. Users complained about the hours spent manually categorizing expenses, leading to low engagement. The opportunity was to create a "zero-effort" finance app that used AI to automate the most time-consuming tasks.

The Process & Solution

By analyzing user data, we identified expense categorization as the biggest pain point. We developed an AI model to automate this process, which saved users an average of 10 hours per month. We also ensured the architecture was robust, successfully supporting 5x user growth without performance degradation.

The Impact

The focus on AI-driven automation resulted in strong product outcomes:

  • A 35% increase in user engagement through features like automated budgeting alerts.
  • A significant increase in positive app store reviews, specifically mentioning the automation feature.

Case Study: Brightyield Golden Resources

Overview

As Business Manager at Brightyield Golden Resources Limited, a finance firm in Abuja, Nigeria, specializing in providing loans to police officers, I led initiatives to streamline operations and enhance customer satisfaction. From May 2021 to February 2023, I focused on transforming the loan application and approval process, which was previously manual and prone to delays.

Challenge

Brightyield served a niche market of police officers seeking quick, reliable loans, but the existing system relied on paper-based applications, manual verifications, and siloed communication between departments.

  • Extended Processing Times: Loan approvals often took 7-10 days.
  • High Error Rates: Manual data entry resulted in inaccuracies, increasing operational costs by ~25%.
  • Limited Scalability: The firm struggled to handle 30% year-over-year client growth.

Solution

I proposed digitizing the loan processing workflow through a custom resource management tool integrated with existing CRM systems:

  • Automation: Introduced automated verification checks for applicant eligibility.
  • Data-Driven Insights: Implemented KPI dashboards for real-time tracking.
  • User-Centric Design: Mobile-friendly interfaces for on-duty police officers.

This resulted in 20% improved operational efficiency and 15% reduction in project delays.

Case Study: SafeTrip

Overview

SafeTrip is a single-page web application for a bus transportation and logistics company, providing a user-friendly interface for booking interstate and metro bus tickets, along with a comprehensive admin panel for managing company operations.

Key Features

  • Interstate Booking: Book bus tickets between major Nigerian cities with real-time availability.
  • First & Last Mile (Metro) Booking: Book tickets for LAMATA franchise routes within Lagos.
  • Dynamic Pricing & Scheduling: All routes, schedules, and prices are fetched in real-time from the backend.
  • Accurate Seat Availability: Real-time seat availability calculated based on current booking data.

Admin Panel

A full-featured dashboard for managing the company's operations:

  • CRUD for Schedules: Create, read, update, and delete schedules with support for recurring daily schedules.
  • CRUD for Vehicles: Manage the company's fleet of vehicles.
  • CRUD for Routes: Manage interstate and metro routes.
  • View Bookings: View and manage all customer bookings.

Technology Stack

  • Frontend: React, Vite, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS
  • Backend: Supabase (PostgreSQL)
